approvalContract.rule: A development recommendation or user instruction is not legal, accounting, privacy, security, provider, or production approval. Missing named accountable evidence retains a fail-closed status.

internalPackageAcceptance.rule: Record a traceable response from the accountable owner for the specific reviewed scope. Development execution authority is already granted; this is package acceptance, not a new production or X1 signature gate.

decisions.title: Market model for Phases 0–3
decisions.rationale: Existing consent, statement, referral, and supplier-proposal foundations can produce governed participation value without public marketplace risk.

decisions.title: Program WIP policy
decisions.rationale: Preserves source-owner review and prevents dashboard, control, and external-delivery work from advancing without evidence.

decisions.title: Canonical Phase 1 routes
decisions.rationale: The routes already own the corresponding workflows and evidence; a new generic analytics route would duplicate them.

acceptanceRequest.decisionRequired: Accept or revise the 12 canonical jobs, all 53 KPI ownership assignments and canonical drill-through destinations in ownership registry v1.1.0. Existing navigation remains; subsequent consolidation needs its own reviewed change.
acceptanceRequest.dueBefore: P0-02 acceptance and activation of P0-04/P0-06
acceptanceRequest.unlocks: P0-02 owner acceptance only; does not waive TypeScript or certify runtime access.

decisions.title: Organization analytical context
decisions.rationale: Hard-coded currency and server-local dates are unsafe across tenants. Periods use inclusive start and exclusive end to avoid millisecond ambiguity.

acceptanceRequest.decisionRequired: Accept or revise remediation design v1: organization currency and IANA timezone, explicit half-open periods, authorized scope, Decimal source aggregation, per-client currency separation, unavailable states and target-model context matrix.
acceptanceRequest.unlocks: Approved implementation design; no runtime completion claim.

decisions.title: Analytical write authority
decisions.rationale: Source-domain services retain ledger, payment, purchasing, inventory, payroll, and accounting write authority.

decisions.title: External delivery channel and provider
decisions.recommendation: Transactional email first; WhatsApp only with provider, template, consent, callback, secret-custody, and country evidence.
decisions.disablePolicy: All outbound channels remain disabled until G2.

decisions.title: Privacy, consent, retention, and wrong-recipient policy
decisions.recommendation: Purpose-bound transactional consent, aggregate-only growth analytics, minimum cohort thresholds, expiry/revocation, suppression, retention/deletion, and wrong-recipient response.

decisions.title: Cross-tenant participant identity
decisions.rationale: Current suppliers, customers, users, and grants are tenant-scoped and do not constitute verified shared marketplace identities.

decisions.title: Forecast scenario authority
decisions.rationale: A 13-week read model may compose source facts, but saved/approved scenarios require a separately governed maker-checker lifecycle.

decisions.accountableRole: Product Program Lead and Finance Owner
decisions.decisionRequired: Resolve roadmap design-only wording versus the registry runtime acceptance criteria. Recommended: retain strict runtime completion within P0-03. Alternative: explicitly amend scope and reassign all three runtime criteria and release dependencies to P1-01.
decisions.unlocks: Unambiguous package completion boundary. No automatic amendment has been made.
decisions.title: P0-03 acceptance scope reconciliation

decisions.decisionRequired: Provide the approved currency catalog/list and version; approve display rounding and currency precision, organization-calendar day/comparison periods, forecast-start convention and separate elapsed-age versus business-day SLA semantics.
decisions.dueBefore: Finalizing runtime currency eligibility and calendar/rounding behavior
decisions.unlocks: Implementation can enforce a product-approved currency policy. Intl precision and currency test fixtures alone are not approval.
decisions.title: Supported currency and analytical calendar/display policy
